## Details

<a id="cell_scan_reset"></a>
### [`cell_scan_reset`](../../../../src/engine/element_tables.asm#L6) `$5EE8-$5F27`

*data*

For each cell code $00-$3f: the code that the scan writes back after it passed the cell. 0 keeps the cell. Changes: $0c-$0f to $08-$0b, $11 to $10, $13 to $12, $15 to $14, $17 to $16. More changes: $34-$37 to $30-$33, $39 to $38, $3b to $3a.

- **Read by:** [`scan_cave`](cave_scan.md#scan_cave)

<a id="cell_glyph_chars"></a>
### [`cell_glyph_chars`](../../../../src/engine/element_tables.asm#L14) `$5F28-$5F67`

*data*

For each cell code $00-$3f: the first of the four characters that show the cell (n, n+1, n+16, n+17).

- **Read by:** [`draw_cell`](cell_draw.md#draw_cell)

<a id="element_handler_lo"></a>
### [`element_handler_lo`](../../../../src/engine/element_tables.asm#L24) `$5F68`

*data*

64 words, one for each cell code: the routine that the scan jumps to through $38. A high byte of 0 means no routine. Codes and routines: $04 $6d54, $05 and $25 $7344, $08-$0b $6dda, $10 $7360, $12 $73ad, $14 $6f87, $16 $6f05. More codes: $1b-$24 $72d3, $26-$28 $72f0, $30-$33 $6ead, $38 $7294, $3a $6fd0.

- **Read by:** [`scan_cave`](cave_scan.md#scan_cave)

<a id="element_handler_hi"></a>
### [`element_handler_hi`](../../../../src/engine/element_tables.asm#L26) `$5F69-$5FE7`

*data*

High byte of the routine address.

- **Read by:** [`scan_cave`](cave_scan.md#scan_cave)
